standard.summary: 除了适配器增量外，把所有可训练的基础权重矩阵也纳入 SVD 扫描。
standard.effect: 默认关 = 只扫适配器增量（便宜）。打开后大模型上开销明显增大——这正是它默认关的原因。
standard.whenToUse: 全量微调（没有适配器层）想看权重健康度时打开。
standard.avoidWhen: 大模型 + 小检查间隔时别开，会明显拖慢训练。

standard_en.summary: Besides adapter deltas, include every trainable base weight matrix in the SVD sweep.
standard_en.effect: Default off = adapter deltas only (cheap). On, the cost grows noticeably on large models — that is why it is opt-in.
standard_en.whenToUse: Enable for full finetunes (no adapter layers) to watch weight health.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable on large models with a small check interval.
